packtoggle.button.save.tooltip: Remembers the active resource packs and their order.
packtoggle.button.remove.tooltip: Takes all resource packs out, so only the default look is left.
packtoggle.button.restore.tooltip: Puts the saved resource packs back in, in the saved order.
packtoggle.button.restore.none: No packs saved yet. Use "Save packs" first.
packtoggle.toast.title: Pack Toggle
packtoggle.toast.nothing_active: No resource packs active to save
packtoggle.tutorial.description: Switches all your resource packs off and back on in the right order.
packtoggle.tutorial.save.title: Save your pack order
packtoggle.tutorial.save.text: Open Options > Resource Packs and click "Save packs". Pack Toggle remembers your active packs and their order.
packtoggle.tutorial.switch.title: Take them out, put them back
packtoggle.tutorial.switch.text: "Remove packs" leaves only the default look. "Add packs" brings everything back in the saved order. Click Done to apply.
packtoggle.tutorial.hotkey.title: Or just press %s
packtoggle.tutorial.hotkey.text: In game, one press switches your packs off and the next one brings them back. No menu needed.
packtoggle.news.1_2_0.folder: Saved packs now live in config/KCMods/packtoggle/. Your saved order is moved there automatically.
packtoggle.news.1_2_0.news: After an update, a short "What's new" like this one appears once.
packtoggle.news.1_1_1.menu: The tour also appears on clients with their own main menu, like NoRisk.
packtoggle.news.1_2_1.hotkey: The hotkey remembers packs you added or reordered after saving, instead of bringing back only the old ones.
packtoggle.news.1_2_1.hints: Short hints when a pack is made for another version, or when resources are still loading.
packtoggle.toast.restored_incompatible: Added %s pack(s) back, %s made for another version
packtoggle.toast.still_loading: Resources are still loading - try again in a moment
